milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow concrete trail runs diagonally from spawn-relative (2,-1,2) to (6,-1,6), with the midpoint at (4,0,4). max_distance is set to 5 so the player must actually walk toward the trail (spawn is ~5.7 blocks away, so the player needs to close some distance). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the concrete, confirming visual discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The TNT block is at spawn-relative (9,1,9) inside the brown stained glass structure. max_distance is set to 8 so the player must walk along the trail and approach the structure (spawn is ~12.9 blocks away from the TNT). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the TNT, which is visible through the semi-transparent glass walls or through the doorway.

Uses inventory_has because the player has a Silk Touch iron pickaxe, which causes brown stained glass to drop itself as an item when mined. Without Silk Touch, glass drops nothing. The player must mine at least 1 block from the structure's walls, floor, or roof. The item 'brown_stained_glass' will appear in inventory after mining with Silk Touch, making this the most reliable and direct check for the mine task.
